name: Fairy Falls
description: Walk through lodgepole pine forest to a tall waterfall near the Grand Prismatic Spring overlook.

name: Mystic Falls
description: Follow the Little Firehole River to a waterfall, with an optional climb to an overlook above the basin.

name: Lone Star Geyser
description: A mostly level route follows the Firehole River to a geyser in a quiet forest clearing.

name: Avalanche Peak
description: A steep climb above the tree line rewards hikers with broad views of Yellowstone's eastern ranges.

name: Taggart Lake
description: A forest-and-meadow loop reaches a clear lake beneath the dramatic Teton front.

name: Delta Lake
description: A demanding route climbs to a vivid alpine lake; the final section is steep and unmaintained.
